summary: Plans a multi-year phaseout of the 6bone, the IPv6 testbed network that the IETF established in 1996, along with its 3FFE::/16 address allocation. IPv6 was starting production deployment, so testing space could be retired. It obsoletes RFC 2471 and is informational.

eli5.summary: The 6bone was a practice track for IPv6 before the real roads were built. This is the schedule for taking the practice track down once the real roads are open.
